item.title: ‘Something Very Bad Is Going To Happen’ Teaser: Stranger Things EPs & ‘Baby Reindeer’ Director Bring Wedding-Week Horror To Netflix This March
item.description: Weddings are supposed to be the rare story that ends with applause—candles, vows, a room full of witnesses insisting this is the safest bet you’ll ever make. Netflix’s first teaser for “Something Very Bad Is Going To Happen” flips that promise into a horror countdown, turning the week before the ceremony into a pressure chamber where superstition starts feeling like instinct and every “sign” reads like a warning label you can’t peel off. item.title: ‘Jason Statham Stole My Bike’: David Leitch Reunites With Jason Statham For Big-Budget Action-Comedy Swing
item.description: Berlin buyers love a clean, loud pitch: a star whose name travels, a director with a reliable action grammar, and a title that basically writes the one-sheet for you. item.description: With their chilling rape-revenge debut “Violation,” the filmmaking duo Madeleine Sims-Fewer and Dusty Mancinelli set a new precedent for visceral, female-fronted horror. item.title: ‘Wuthering Heights’ Romances To $40 Million Over Valentine’s Day Weekend Box Office
item.description: It may not be a romance for the ages, but Warner Bros. is estimating an $82 million worldwide debut for Emerald Fennell’s “Wuthering Heights” this weekend. The Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi gothic love story or revenge story (or both) pulled in $42 million overseas over the three-day frame and another $40 million over the four-day President’s Day holiday.
